c.description:
One Burrard Place


$6000 unfurnished
$6400 (utilities/wifi not included)
$6800 furnished

Beautifully furnished high-rise residence located in the heart of Downtown Vancouver. This well-designed 2-bedroom home offers a bright and modern living space with floor-to-ceiling windows and city views. The open-concept living and dining area flows seamlessly into a contemporary kitchen with modern appliances and ample cabinetry. Both bedrooms are generously sized and fully furnished, making the home ideal for comfortable living or a home office setup.

A rare and highly desirable feature is the large in-suite storage room, providing exceptional additional space. The unit is completed with a stylish bathroom and convenient in-suite laundry.

Residents enjoy fantastic building amenities, including an indoor swimming pool, fully equipped gym, yoga studio, multiple social lounges, and a beautiful party room thoughtfully designed and fully equipped for entertaining. The building is well managed with 24 hour concierge and perfectly located just steps from Yaletown, shopping, top restaurants, public transit, and the Seawall. This furnished, move-in-ready home is perfect for professionals or small families seeking a premium downtown lifestyle.
